evidence.en:
The JOURNAL OPTION from GOIÂNIA-GO published a report about the fall of an OVNI in MORRINHOS. The notification was based on information from a reference. According to the reporter, the event occurred on August 12, 1981, but according to the knowledge of this institution, the occurrence was in 1980.

In this report, it says:

The maker was ABRIEL ESTEVÃO REIS and his son, REINALDO ESTEVÃO. They testified to the fall of an object that appeared with a trail in the press located in their property. T

1 - On 05/05/80, while the corvette CV “MEARIM” was navigating the Amazon River in the PARINTINS/AM region between 04:00 and 04:15 hours, the watch personnel saw unidentified objects in the stretch between VILA AMAZÔNIA and the city of PARINTINS. These objects had a yellowish light and, despite being within radar range, were not detected by radar; they were only seen visually by the personnel on duty at the time.
